name: Koala Gifts
summary: Shopify app by ProfitKoala for free gifts with purchase, BOGO and buy-X-get-Y offers, gift pickers, product add-ons and add-to-cart upsell pop-ups, with plans set by the store's Shopify plan rather than by orders or revenue.
best_for: Shopify stores that want free gifts with purchase, BOGO and buy-X-get-Y offers, a gift picker, product add-ons and add-to-cart upsell pop-ups for a flat monthly price, with no cap on orders or revenue
skip_if: your store is on Shopify Advanced or Plus and runs only the occasional gift offer, since the price follows your Shopify plan and starts at $49.99 there; your promotions rely on discount codes and you do not want to check how each one combines with the gift; or you expect one ProfitKoala app to cover bundles, upsells and gifts, since they are sold as separate subscriptions
honest_knock:
The price follows your Shopify plan, not how much you use the app. A store on Shopify Advanced pays $49.99 a month for the same feature list a Basic store gets for $9.99, even if it runs one gift offer a quarter. The fee does not move by itself: the help centre says that if you upgrade your Shopify plan you have 14 days to upgrade in the app as well to keep your offers active. Downgrades are pro-rated; cancellations are not.

The gift mechanics have a few traps that the help centre documents itself. The gift product must carry a normal price above zero, because the app gives it away with a 100% discount; a gift priced at zero and published to the storefront can be bought without any of the offer's conditions. A gift can also flip from free to full price at checkout when the customer adds another discount code, unless that other discount is set to combine with product discounts. And a minimum-spend rule reads the price before discounts: with a $100 threshold, a $150 product with a 50% code still earns the gift at $75. The vendor's workaround is to use compare-at prices instead of discount codes.

There is a ceiling on offers, set by Shopify rather than by the plan. Shopify allows 25 automatic discounts per store, and the app packs about ten offers into each, which the help centre puts at roughly 90 to 250 offers. Disabling one Koala discount in Shopify's own discount screen can switch off several offers at once.

The critical reviews are few but specific. A US merchant wrote in March 2025, after six days, that the gift was not applied to orders correctly and that they had to refund customers. An Australian merchant disliked the long generated discount code the gift shows at checkout (February 2025). A US merchant who paid $599 a year for another ProfitKoala app objected in November 2025 to needing a separate subscription for BOGO offers, and a merchant in Ecuador noted in April 2025 that the app had been free and now costs money. The vendor's replies to all of them are the same template asking for an email. We have not installed the app.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · per month for stores on Shopify's Basic plan, or $95.88 a year
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-03 on apps.shopify.com/upsell-koala-gift and in the vendor's billing articles at koala-gift.crisp.help) Priced on the store's Shopify plan, not on use: the four plans carry the names of Shopify's own plans and the listing gives each the same feature list. Basic is $9.99 a month or $95.88 a year, Shopify $29.99 or $287.88, Advanced $49.99 or $479.88, and Shopify Plus $99.99 or $959.88. The listing says the yearly price saves 20%; a help article dated July 2025 says up to 50%, and the listing is the page you are billed from. Every plan has a 14-day free trial and is free for development stores. The help centre says there are no usage limits: unlimited orders and revenue at an unchanged price. Owners of several stores can ask support for special pricing. All charges are in USD, billed through Shopify every 30 days. Developer ProfitKoala, with an address in Vilnius, Lithuania; the listing gives a launch date of 9 October 2024 and shows 383 reviews, six of them at three stars or lower.

cost_traps.label: Key features are paid add-ons
cost_traps.evidence: A US merchant who paid $599 a year for another ProfitKoala app objected in November 2025 to needing a separate subscription for BOGO offers, and a merchant in Ecuador noted in April 2025 that the app had been free and now costs money.

compare_with.name: Koala Bundles
compare_with.why: Koala Bundles comes from the same developer and is the closest comparison in our own dossiers, and the listing says the two work together. They are priced on different things. Koala Bundles, read on 30 September 2026, is metered on the bundle revenue its offers bring in: $12.99 a month up to $1,000, $19.99 up to $5,000 and $59.99 with no ceiling. Koala Gifts, read on 3 October 2026, ignores revenue and charges by the store's Shopify plan: $9.99 on Basic, $29.99 on Shopify, $49.99 on Advanced and $99.99 on Plus. A small store on Shopify's Basic plan pays less for gifts than for bundles; a large store on Advanced pays $49.99 for gifts whatever they sell, which is cheaper than Unlimited bundles. Pick Koala Bundles for quantity breaks and multi-product bundles, Koala Gifts for gift-with-purchase, BOGO and buy-X-get-Y offers.
